baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired constructions 'they took patrons' and 'the spider took a house' join choosing a protector to constructing a shelter.
baseline_models.mechanism: Voluntary acquisition converts patrons into a built protection system. The spider's woven dwelling has the name and appearance of shelter but lacks the force needed to perform shelter, so deliberate construction and possession do not establish protective capacity.

activation_trace.role: General likeness makes the two acts of taking functionally comparable.
Acquiring something for oneself supplies the shared act that builds both protection systems.
Love, alliance, and aid specify the protective service expected from the acquired patrons.
The weaving creature supplies a visibly fabricated but flimsy material system.
Dwelling and refuge supply the function against which the construction is tested.
Loss of force and resolve marks functional failure rather than mere ugliness.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely calls non-divine allies weak.
changed_reading.after: The ayah models patron-selection as self-built protection whose architecture cannot perform the sheltering work for which it was chosen.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Plural patrons, a weaving spider, and the repeated house lexeme allow the protected unit to be read as a network or household, not only as one object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Patrons are adjacent, allied relations; a house can name its people; and the spider makes connected threads. Numerous ties can therefore compose a social household whose density looks like support while no tie bears decisive load.

activation_trace.role: Uninterrupted nearness supplies the adjacency from which a network is formed.
Alliance and mutual aid make those adjacent ties a social support system.
Household and dependents let 'house' denote a corporate relational unit.
Fine interlaced threads materialize many connections without load-bearing strength.
Weak force diagnoses the network at the level of collective performance.

changed_reading.before: Each patron is separately an inadequate protector.
changed_reading.after: The plural patrons can compose a woven social household: connectedness itself mimics security, although the collective structure remains unable to bear a protective load.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah frames the spider construction as a parabolic sign and closes by making knowledge the unrealized condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: A recognizable house-form prompts an inference of refuge. The parable interrupts that inference by making functional weakness the mark to be read; ignorance is thus failure to distinguish a shelter's label and visible complexity from its actual capacity.

activation_trace.role: The parable as lesson or sign turns the material comparison into evidence for reflection.
A distinguishing mark supplies the diagnostic mode by which the house should be recognized.
Disclosure to the knower makes the closing counterfactual an epistemic failure.
The familiar refuge-form creates the misleading first classification.
Functional weakness is the corrective mark hidden by the shelter label.

changed_reading.before: 'If they knew' is a generic charge of ignorance.
changed_reading.after: The ignorance is a specific category error: seeing a complex thing called a house and inferring that it can shelter without reading its functional marks.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's opening assay and later affliction put professed supports under load. Read through that sequence, the web's weakness is latent capacity exposed by trial: a structure may look adequate while unstressed, then disclose what it is when protection is demanded.

activation_trace.role: Refuge supplies the structure whose performance is placed under load.
Weak force names the latent incapacity that testing reveals.
Assaying metal or persons supplies a test that discloses hidden quality.
Affliction supplies the actual load under which a claimed support must work.
Knowledge as disclosure states the epistemic result of the assay.

structural_cues: The surah opens with profession followed by trial and repeatedly couples trial with disclosure before naming the weakest house.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, affliction, disclosure, refuge, and weakness; I supply the engineering arrow that stress reveals load-bearing capacity. A live alternative is that trial exposes loyalty rather than structural capacity, but both still test whether patrons protect.

changed_reading.before: The spider house possesses a static property called weakness.
changed_reading.after: Its weakness is failure under demand: patronage is an apparently coherent support system whose true capacity becomes visible only when trial applies load.

context_deltas.mechanism: The invitation to follow a group's path comes with a promise to carry another's liabilities, yet the promised carriers cannot carry them. This gives patronage a precise social function: a web of affiliation offers pooled liability and surety, but every burden remains attached to its bearer.

activation_trace.role: Alliance and aid anchor the patrons as parties expected to support one another.
Household supplies the corporate unit within which support is promised.
An attached consequence makes following generate a liability that does not disappear into the group.
Surety and guarantee supply the explicit promise that the affiliative structure fails to honor.
Bearing responsibility and burden restores liability to the supposed guarantors themselves.

structural_cues: The promise 'follow our path and we will carry your errors' is immediately denied, then the carriers are assigned their own accumulated loads.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alliance, household, following, surety, and nontransferable burden; I infer that one protective service expected from patrons is risk transfer. The alternative is rhetorical deception without a stable institution, but the failed guarantee still gives the web an operational meaning.

changed_reading.before: Patrons fail mainly as defenders against an outside threat.
changed_reading.after: They also fail as a mutual-guarantee structure: affiliation promises to absorb liability, but its threads transmit obligation without redistributing its weight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier near-verbatim act of taking objects apart from God is said to produce affection between people. The protective house is therefore socially woven from recognition and loyalty; later mutual disavowal and expulsion pull those links in opposite directions and dismantle the very medium that made the patrons seem strong.

activation_trace.role: Affection and alliance anchor the focus patrons as relational ties.
Interlaced fine threads provide the material analogy for a bond-made network.
Household makes the web a social body rather than merely an external roof.
Taking something for oneself repeats the focus act and locates its social purpose.
Love and affection supply the adhesive from which the patronal network is made.
A connection standing between parties supplies the individual links of the social web.
Mutual disavowal withdraws recognition and snaps the network's reciprocal commitments.
Expulsion in anger reverses the proximity on which patronage depended.

structural_cues: 29:25 anticipates the focus wording 'you took, apart from God' and then narrates the bond's reversal from affection to reciprocal repudiation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated taking formula, affection between parties, linkage, disavowal, and expulsion; I infer that shared patronage manufactures group cohesion and that cohesion is one expected form of protection. The live alternative is that affection merely motivates the practice, but either direction makes the house depend on reversible relations.

changed_reading.before: The web resembles a set of many individually weak allies.
changed_reading.after: The web is the affection-mediated social body produced by shared patronage; its weakness is that recognition, proximity, and aid can all reverse from within.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, taking moves from human acquisition to punitive seizure. The humans take patrons and the spider takes a house, but the preceding agents are themselves taken for guilt. The repeated root turns possession into an unstable claim: choosing means of control cannot prevent becoming the object controlled.

activation_trace.role: Self-directed acquisition gives both focus subjects an apparent position of agency and control.
Mastery and reaching the goal identify the control expected from acquired patrons.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing reverses the direction of the focus subjects' acquisitive agency.
Guilt supplies the bond by which the supposed takers become liable to seizure.

structural_cues: The preceding ayah repeats the taking root twice, and the focus immediately repeats it twice again with a changed direction of agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent punitive taking, culpability, acquisitive taking, and expected mastery; I infer a deliberate agency reversal across the boundary. The alternative is ordinary lexical repetition, but the fourfold sequence still makes control and exposure collide.

changed_reading.before: Taking patrons is simply a wrong choice of object.
changed_reading.after: It is also a false claim to controlling agency: those who construct possession-based security remain available to be seized, just as their chosen structure cannot master events.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah leaves visible remains, directs attention to former dwellings, then explicitly says that such parables are rendered for reasoning. The spider house joins ruined settlements as a forensic exhibit: built form survives to testify that apparent habitation did not provide security.

activation_trace.role: A parable functioning as lesson and sign anchors the focus as inspectable evidence.
The spider dwelling is the small-scale built remains placed before the reader.
A visible mark supplies the forensic status of what destruction leaves behind.
Manifest disclosure makes former settlements legible rather than merely absent.
Inhabited dwellings provide the macro-scale analogue whose remains disclose failed security.
The lesson-sign branch explicitly classifies the surrounding examples as material for recognition.
Rendering and showing a parable turns comparison into a presented image.
Reason that restrains ignorance states the cognitive operation expected of the evidence-reader.

structural_cues: A sequence of destroyed peoples, visible remnants, and former dwellings leads directly into the spider dwelling and then into a meta-statement about reasoning through parables.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs, legible settlements, a small dwelling, and explicit parable-reasoning; I infer that ruin and web are to be inspected under one evidentiary mode. A live alternative keeps historical remains and animal image as separate examples, but both still convert built form into testimony.

changed_reading.before: The spider is a convenient illustration of abstract weakness.
changed_reading.after: Its house is a miniature ruin presented beside failed settlements: an extant structure whose form testifies against the security once inferred from habitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later habitation is not abolished but re-sourced: secure upper rooms are assigned, while the occupants rely on their Lord. This contrasts a dwelling acquired through substitute patrons with a dwelling into which one is placed, and contrasts possession as control with reliance on the one who maintains it.

activation_trace.role: Self-acquisition supplies the focus model of securing a support structure for oneself.
Dwelling and refuge anchor the shared function across the contrast.
Being settled into an appointed dwelling reverses the source of habitation from self-securing to granted emplacement.
An upper chamber supplies a genuinely protective built destination rather than an anti-house.
Reliance supplies the relational mode corresponding to granted rather than possessed security.

structural_cues: The later promise of emplacement in chambers is immediately characterized by patience and reliance on the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-acquisition, refuge, granted emplacement, upper rooms, and reliance; I infer that the decisive contrast is who grounds and maintains shelter, not a rejection of shelter itself. The alternative is simply present versus future reward, which still preserves the source contrast.

changed_reading.before: The ayah makes every attempt at habitation or dependence suspect.
changed_reading.after: It distinguishes self-secured refuge through acquired patrons from granted habitation sustained through reliance; the problem is the shelter's ground and maintainer, not shelter as such.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact closing condition about knowing returns when lower life is contrasted with the final abode as true life. That echo stretches the house comparison across time: patronal security belongs to a distracting, lower horizon and is weak because it cannot carry habitation into the enduring mode of life.

activation_trace.role: Dwelling anchors the focus structure to the later contrast between present life and final abode.
Unrealized disclosure supplies the refrain whose return licenses the temporal extension.
Life as effective good distinguishes mere temporal animation from life that truly benefits.
The lower or present world supplies the limited horizon within which the weak shelter seems sufficient.
Diversion supplies the attentional mechanism that mistakes provisional support for durable abode.
Situated occurrence in time sharpens the contrast between temporary being and enduring habitation.
The repeated unrealized knowing explicitly reconnects the abode contrast to the focus diagnosis.

structural_cues: 29:41 and 29:64 close with the same counterfactual refrain, while the latter explicitly contrasts lower life with the final abode and true life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a house, lower life, final abode, effective life, and an exact epistemic refrain; I infer that load-bearing includes temporal endurance. The alternative is that the refrain only repeats human ignorance, but the abode vocabulary keeps the temporal reading live.

changed_reading.before: Weakness is chiefly the web's material inability to block harm now.
changed_reading.after: Weakness also names temporal incapacity: substitute patronage builds a dwelling fitted only to a lower, distracting horizon and unable to carry life into its enduring abode.

context_deltas.mechanism: At sea, danger strips devotion of partners; on land, a bounded sanctuary feels secure while people outside are snatched away, yet belief attaches to what lacks stability. The spider house can thus model a local bubble of felt safety: proximity to a boundary calms the heart, but the boundary is mistaken for the source of preservation.

activation_trace.role: Refuge supplies the bounded zone within which safety is expected.
Nearness supplies the felt protection created by being inside or adjacent to the chosen network.
Exclusive devotion under exposed danger reveals which relation is treated as operative when constructed buffers vanish.
A spatial sanctuary supplies an actual bounded security zone.
Heart-settling security links the experience of safety to the act of entrusting belief.
Rapid snatching supplies the predatory threat immediately outside the protected boundary.
Loss of truth and stability diagnoses the object to which felt security is wrongly attached.

structural_cues: The closing movement juxtaposes exposed danger at sea, exclusive calling, a secure sanctuary, surrounding abduction, and belief in the unstable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exclusive crisis-reliance, a bounded sanctuary, inner security, outer capture, and unstable belief; I infer that people can mistake the experienced safety of a zone for autonomous power in its visible boundary. The alternative is simple ingratitude for divine protection, which still sharpens the source-of-security error.

changed_reading.before: The spider house is weak because it is physically thin.
changed_reading.after: It also figures a bounded bubble that successfully produces the feeling of safety while concealing that its visible perimeter is not the agency preserving those inside.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a form-distant branch of the path root in which a woven film covers the eye. It remains anchored by the spider's weaving and the focus close on knowing, while the context pairs blocked path with claimed insight. Render only as a possible cognitive-material overlay, not as the lexical sense of 'path' in 29:38.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The woven spider image and the unrealized knowing can receive a contextual image of insight occluded by something itself woven.

activation_trace.role: Fine weaving supplies the material form transferred to perceptual obstruction.
Failed disclosure anchors the outlier in the focus ayah's epistemic close.
Making conduct appear beautiful supplies the attractive surface that keeps the obstruction unnoticed.
Turning away supplies the obstruction's directional effect.
A woven film over the eye supplies the strange but explicit bridge from web-making to occluded route-perception.
Inner sight makes the claim of being perceptive the faculty compromised by the woven overlay.

changed_reading.before: The web is only an external refuge that fails to protect.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also be the attractive weave laid across perception: a support-system that blocks the route while allowing its occupants to regard themselves as insightful.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus grammar presents humans and spider as active takers, whereas the cited taking branch describes a charm that takes hold and restrains opinion. It remains anchored in the repeated taking root and the web's trapping affordance, with contextual turning-away as a directional check. Render as an agency inversion or secondary resonance, never as the primary morphology of the focus verbs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated taking verb and the spider's web permit the chooser's acquisition to reverse into the chooser being held by what was acquired.

activation_trace.role: A taking charm that restrains judgment supplies the inversion from active acquisition to being held in an opinion.
The weaving creature supplies a structure capable of changing house into trap.
Being turned away supplies the observable directional result of constrained judgment.
Reversal from the proper direction supplies the later cognitive motion produced by the hold.

changed_reading.before: People freely take patrons and then happen to receive no protection.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the act of taking closes into captivation: the acquired network takes hold of judgment, so its makers inhabit a web that also holds and redirects them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation moves from the named spider to the later generic creature and from house-building to provision, so the causal link is reader-supplied. It remains anchored in the focus animal, repeated acquisition, and shelter function, while 29:60 explicitly denies that creatures carry their own sustenance. Render as an ecological extension of false self-sufficiency, not as a claim that the focus explicitly discusses food.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A creature visibly takes or builds a house for itself; the later creature cue challenges the broader inference that an animal's own apparatus carries its security and sustenance.

activation_trace.role: The web-making creature anchors the later ecological generalization.
Making something one's own supplies the apparent self-provisioning posture.
Shelter extends the provision question from food to maintained creaturely security.
A creature creeping on earth supplies the class into which the spider can visibly be folded.
Carrying an external load supplies the denied model of self-contained provision.
Sustaining food shifts maintenance from the creature's apparatus to divine provision.

changed_reading.before: The spider is selected only because its shelter is materially frail.
changed_reading.after: As an ecological countermodel, its self-made apparatus dramatizes the larger error of treating creaturely equipment as self-sufficient provision rather than a dependent means.

strongest_changes: Weakness became load-dependent failure disclosed by trial rather than a merely static material property.
The patronal web became a failed social surety whose promises transmit liability without carrying it.
The affection that weaves a shared patronal household was shown to reverse internally into disavowal and expulsion.
The spider dwelling became a miniature forensic ruin within a sequence of visible failed settlements.
Later granted chambers and reliance separated valid habitation from self-secured refuge through acquired patrons.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah sequence repeatedly changed the scale and direction of the focus image: web became social contract, stress-tested structure, ruined evidence, temporary abode, and felt security boundary. The most unusual live branches reversed agency, making the taker captive to its own weave, and turned weaving into a possible veil over insight.
remaining_uncertainties: The temporal extension from weak house to lower life depends heavily on the repeated closing refrain and is less direct than the social and trial mechanisms.
The sanctuary model cannot by itself decide whether the error lies in boundaries, in attributing agency to them, or simply in ingratitude for protection.
The woven-eye-film and captivation readings are branch-distant secondary resonances and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The provision reading links shelter to sustenance by ecological analogy rather than by an explicit focus-ayah statement.
